name: rqbit
description: Watch a torrent together through rqbit (a torrent client with streaming): add a magnet link or a .torrent file on the plugin's page in the admin panel, and its videos stream to everyone in the room while they download – whatever is being watched comes first, also when you skip ahead. Episodes play in order, the next one after the last.
requires: rqbit (github.com/ikatson/rqbit) running where the server reaches its HTTP API, e.g. in Docker next to Couchmate. Only add torrents you have the right to download and share: a torrent always uploads to others while it downloads.

settings.label: Episodes to download ahead of the one playing
Start downloading the first video when a torrent is added
